remarks: Move-in ready and full of charm, this beautifully renovated top floor condo offers a bright, spacious layout with modern finishes throughout. Enjoy cooking in the updated kitchen featuring granite countertops, sleek stainless steel appliances, and hardwood flooring that flows into the hallway.  The expansive living room opens to a private balcony-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Recessed lighting adds a warm, contemporary touch throughout the unit. Lots of closet space and storage in the unit, and additional storage in the basement, so everything has its place. Located close to restaurants, shopping, and public transportation, this top-floor unit also includes access to a community pool-just in time for summer fun!  Please use visitor parking during showings.
